description.ja: 水戸岡鋭治氏オリジナルデザインのパッケージで登場。
description.en: Appears in a package originally designed by Eiji Mitooka.

description.ja: バリエーションパーツとして中間車の屋根が4枚入り、パーツの差替えで初期車・後期車の再現が可能。
description.en: Four intermediate car roofs are included as variation parts, and it is possible to reproduce early and late cars by replacing parts.

description.ja: ※側面パーツは後期車のみ封入しています。（初期車を再現する際は後期車用側面パーツで代用します）
description.en: *Side parts are included only for later models. (When reproducing an early car, use side parts for later cars instead)

description.ja: トレインマークが3種付属！
description.en: Three types of train marks are included!

contents.en: 2 cars (first car x 1, middle car x 1)

contents.ja: バリエーションパーツ付属　（初期車・後期車用中間車屋根〈パンタ付き、パンタなし〉計4枚入り）
contents.en: Variation parts included (intermediate car roof for early and late cars (with and without pantographs), 4 pieces in total)
